notes:
User is a collector interested in autographed sports memorabilia, error coins, international vinyl (especially rare Japanese pressings), stamps, and vintage cameras. They recently added 20 autographed baseballs in the past few months, reflecting rapid growth of their collection, and are considering selling some baseballs, vinyl, and vintage cameras to make room for new acquisitions. Their collection previously included a signed Mike Trout baseball and totaled 15 autographed baseballs before the latest additions; exact current total is unclear. They have asked about current Mike Trout stats, nearby/upcoming coin, stamp, and sports memorabilia events/auctions, but their city has not been provided.

They plan to sell vinyl records and may attend a stamp show next quarter. Suggested marketplaces/resources include Discogs, eBay sold/completed listings, MusicStack, Reverb, local record stores, and local classifieds. For autographed baseballs, suggested resources include eBay sold listings, Steiner, Fanatics, PSA/JSA authentication, Sports Collectors Digest, local shops, Heritage Auctions, and Lelands. Advice emphasizes checking provenance, authenticity, condition, comparable sales, and using reputable authentication/secure payments.

They acquired a 1943 Lincoln Wheat Cent with a copper planchet error and want to learn about error coins; useful resources include PCGS, NGC, CoinWeek, Error Coin Information, Fred Weinberg’s Error Coin Encyclopedia, CoinTalk, Reddit, and professional dealers. They should verify authenticity carefully.

They own a vintage Leica and may buy a lens. Relevant resources include Leica forums/website, Photography Stack Exchange, Reddit, LensRentals, B&H, manufacturer information, and books on Leica history and lenses. Compatibility with the exact Leica model and mount must be checked. They also plan to sell a Leica and other vintage cameras, considering Fred Miranda and Rangefinder Forum; include original lenses/accessories when genuine, functional, well documented, and transparently describe condition, serial numbers, repairs, and separate values.
